name: E1_spice_bound_branch
title: Transistor-level (sky130, ngspice) check of the aCAM lower-bound branch: operating region of the divider transistor, and which transistor mismatch each global drift-compensation node re-exposes after threshold-verify programming

questions.Q1: In which region (subthreshold / saturation / triode) is the divider transistor at the switching point, for realistic sky130 sizing with PCM conductances of 2.5-22.5 uS?
questions.Q2: With the PDK's own mismatch model, threshold-verify programming and uniform PCM drift, which mismatch does each compensation node re-expose (N2 at transistor level)?
questions.Q3: Which node leaves the smaller input-referred bound error, and does the answer depend on the design (N3)?

models.mismatch_hooks: mm_vth0, mm_toxe, mm_voff, mm_nfactor = per-instance standard-normal draws applied through the PDK slopes / sqrt(l*w*mult) (src/pcm_acam/sky130_models.py)

circuit.branch: lower bound: PCM conductance G from V_SL to node X; divider nfet from X to ground, gate = V_DL; X drives the match-line pull-down
circuit.criterion: bound = V_DL at which V_X = V_sw (quasi-static); V_sw = gate voltage at which the pull-down conducts I_sw = 100 nA * W/L with V_DS = 1.8 V
circuit.v_sl_rule: V_SL,nom = V_sw,nom + D (D = PCM voltage at the switching point)

design_rule_note: L_div from the minimum 0.15 um to 8 um, the largest power of two for which the nominal bound at 22.5 uS stays below 1.7 V with D = 0.2 V (pre-run feasibility scan of the nominal device only, 2026-10-14 01:43; 16 um reaches the 1.8 V rail).

mismatch.rng: numpy.random.default_rng([base_seed, 0]); z_div = standard_normal((n_instances, 4)); then z_pd = standard_normal((n_instances, 4)); columns = (vth0, toxe, voff, nfactor); the same draws for every design

settings.pdk: divider mm = z_div, pull-down mm = z_pd (PDK mismatch model)
settings.e02: E0.2-style: gate-referred threshold offsets only, 20 mV sigma on both devices (divider offset = 0.020 * z_div[:,0], pull-down offset = 0.020 * z_pd[:,0]), no other mismatch

programming: threshold verify: G_k(theta) = I_div,k(M0(theta)) / (V_SL,nom - V_sw,k), clipped to [0, g_max]; clipped pairs are flagged and excluded from the primary metric

drift.model: uniform multiplicative factor a(t) = (t / t0)^(-nu), nu = 0.049, t0 = 20 s; perfect tracking a_hat = a

nodes.none: V_DL map unchanged: M0(x) = B_nom(G(x); V_SL,nom)
nodes.dac_remap: input map follows the nominal drifted cell: Ma(x) = B_nom(a_hat * G(x); V_SL,nom)
nodes.dac_gain: E0.2-style linear DAC gain: Mg(x) = V0 + a_hat * (M0(x) - V0), V0 = intercept of the least-squares line of M0 versus G over x in [0, 1] (secondary)
nodes.supply: V_SL(t) = V_sw,nom + D / a_hat, input map M0 unchanged
nodes.ideal: conductance rescaled G -> G / a_hat (mismatch-invariant reference)

metric.error: input-referred bound error in LSB: 15 * (x_eff - theta), x_eff = inverse of the node's input map at the cell's actual bound

regime: nominal divider at V_DS = V_sw,nom and V_GS = bound: subthreshold if V_GS < vth; triode if V_DS < vdsat; otherwise saturation (BSIM4 operating-point vth, vdsat)

checks.C1_desc: nominal full-branch DC simulation (PCM resistor + divider, crossing of V_X = V_sw) equals the I-V inversion, G in {2.5, 7.5, 12.5, 17.5, 22.5} uS at V_SL,nom and V_SL(1y), every design
checks.C2_desc: setting none: |error| <= 0.001 LSB for nodes dac_remap, supply, ideal at every time and theta
checks.C3_desc: every setting: ideal-node |error| <= 0.001 LSB on unclipped pairs (threshold verify reproduces the target)
checks.C4_desc: pdk setting: measured sigma of V_sw within a relative tolerance of max(0.15, 3 / sqrt(2 (n - 1))) (sampling error of a standard deviation; 0.15 for n = 300) of 5.456e-3 / sqrt(0.42 * 0.15) V = 21.74 mV, and for pd_4x within 15 % of 5.456e-3 / sqrt(0.84 * 0.30) V = 10.87 mV
checks.C5_desc: all I-V curves strictly increasing over the used current range; no NaN bound for unclipped pairs
checks.stop_rule: any failed check stops the run before decisions are computed

decisions.primary_condition: setting pdk, designs P1-P4, time 1y, metric rms (LSB)
decisions.D1a: setting div_only: supply rms <= 0.01 LSB in every primary design AND dac_remap rms >= 0.05 LSB in at least one primary design
decisions.D1b: setting pd_only: supply rms >= 0.05 LSB in at least one primary design
decisions.N2_rule: N2 holds at transistor level if D1a and D1b both hold
decisions.D2: setting pdk, 1y: classify N3 as 'supply_better_everywhere' if supply rms < dac_remap rms in all of P1-P4, 'dac_better_everywhere' if dac_remap rms < supply rms in all of P1-P4, otherwise 'design_dependent'
decisions.D2_expectation: design_dependent (first-order: supply better for the short divider P1, dac_remap better for the long divider P4)
decisions.D3: node choice matters if max over P1-P4 of |rms(dac_remap) - rms(supply)| at 1y >= 0.25 LSB; otherwise 'minor'
decisions.secondary: D = 0.4 V designs, 4x pull-down, e02 setting, 1d and 30d, dac_gain node, regime map, per-theta profiles: reported, not used in the decisions

smoke.note: smoke run only confirms that the program runs and the checks pass; no decisions are computed or interpreted
